record.notes: Both signed 9 Sep 2026. EO N-9-26 of 18 Sep 2026 (US-CA-09) orders the Government Operations Agency to complete the requirements of Gov. Code sec. 8898.1 and post application requirements, procedures and criteria for independent verification organizations by 1 May 2027, and to complete the requirements of Gov. Code sec. 11549.82(a) by 1 Dec 2027. Combined into one record because they were enacted together as a single verification and audit framework.

The stored EO N-9-26 PDF (18 Sep 2026) confirms the implementation deadlines and the Government Code sections; the archiver stored it as a secondary source. Neither file gives chapter numbers, the statutory text or an effective date. The leginfo.legislature.ca.gov pages for both bills and for Gov. Code sec. 9600 could not be stored, so the effective date, the chapter numbers and the session label in official_identifier are unconfirmed.

judgment.status_reasoning: Latest event in the stored files: the Governor signed SB 813 and AB 1405 on 9 Sep 2026 (release dated 'Sep 9, 2026', 'today signed legislation'). EO N-9-26 of 18 Sep 2026 sets the first implementation deadlines for 1 May 2027 (Gov. Code sec. 8898.1) and 1 Dec 2027 (sec. 11549.82(a)). Neither stored file contains an effective-date or urgency clause. Under California's general rule, which is not in the stored files (Cal. Const. art. IV sec. 8(c); Gov. Code sec. 9600; the leginfo page could not be stored), a non-urgency statute enacted in a regular session takes effect on 1 January after a 90-day period from enactment. For bills enacted on 9 Sep 2026 that is 1 Jan 2027, which is after today (14 Oct 2026). Status stays 'Adopted, not yet in force'. date_in_force stays null because neither the chaptered text nor the rule could be stored.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope without a scope note: AI-specific state statutes creating independent verification of AI models and an AI auditor registry.
